inherits: m1-draft-0.4/vectors/request-bound.json: all fixtures except rb-2848-does-not-fit keep their expectations (they passed in the Codex run of 0.4).
correction: 0.4 expected rb-2848-does-not-fit to be 65558 bytes, computed with 3-byte list headers at every level. A long-form list header is 1 + L bytes where L is the length of the body length: L = 2 for bodies 256..65535 and L = 3 for bodies 65536..16777215. In the 2848-reference manifest the chunk list body is 65504 (header 3), but the file body (65547), the files-list body (65551) and the top-level body (65557) are all >= 65536, so each of these three headers is 4 bytes. Length = 54 + 23*2848 + 3 = 65561, which matches the Codex run. The bound itself is unaffected: its proof only needs headers to be at least as large as assumed, so 54 + 23N is a lower bound on the length of any valid manifest with N >= 2847 references.
fileBodyParts: path '/a' (3: 82 2f 61) + mime (1: 01) + size (3: 82 + 2-byte value; 5694 for 2847, 5696 for 2848) + contentHash (33) + chunks list total
boundStatement: Unchanged from R4-03: at most 2847 content references, at most 2850 eth_getCode requests per load. Lower bound used in the proof: length >= 54 + 23N for N >= 2847; the exact length can exceed it by the header growth at the 65536 boundary (here +3).
